now.title: Loki S2#3
now.text: Renslayer escapes the TVA and races Mobius and Loki to reach Victor Timely in 1893. When Mobius confronts her, she insists she has always put the TVA above her own happiness.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mobius's old friend, now a fugitive racing him to Victor Timely.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Renslayer's old friend, who races her to Victor Timely and confronts her.

proposed.text: Renslayer races Mobius and Loki to reach Victor Timely in 1893. When Mobius confronts her, she insists she has always put the TVA above her own happiness.

changes.evidence: Renslayer does not escape the TVA in Loki S2#3 ('1893'). She walked out of the TVA through a Timedoor in S1#6 ('For All Time. Always.'), which stage 2 already covers. In S2#3 the TVA is tracking her TemPad, and she is already rogue when Loki and Mobius follow her to the 1893 World's Fair. The 'happiness' line is confirmed: 'After all the times I put the TVA above myself, even at the cost of my own happiness'.

owner_calls.question: After S3#17 Hive takes control of Daisy, and from S3#18 to S3#21 she serves Hive alongside Giyera. In S3#22, once she is free, she tries to convince Giyera that she is still under Hive's sway, and Fitz kills him. Should the mind-controlled stretch on the same side be added as a stage, or does it stay a single 'enemy' through-line?
options: No change: the mind control is not a real turn between them
Add a stage at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18 (ally, under Hive's control)
Add an enemy stage at Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22 for Daisy's bluff and Giyera's death
owner_calls.evidence: Giyera's page: Hive tells Giyera that he now has his own spy inside S.H.I.E.L.D. (Daisy) (AoS317). In AoS322 Daisy tries to convince Giyera that she is under Hive's sway, Giyera refuses to believe it, and Fitz shoots him dead.
